title: Puthoff's Silurian hypothesis paper

tellings.quote: Hal Putoff who actually lives out here in Austin who wrote an interesting paper about the saluran hypothesis

plain: The researcher Hal Puthoff, who Michels says lives in Austin, Texas, wrote a paper on the Silurian hypothesis, the idea that an advanced civilisation could have lived on Earth long before humans and left almost no trace. Michels mentions the paper in passing and calls it interesting, but says nothing about what it argues.
